title: APAEA Research Platform
subtitle: Where membership, research and scholarly publishing come together.
summary: A research and membership platform spanning individual and institutional accounts, submissions, peer review, journals, conferences and publishing tools.
overview: The APAEA source inventory describes an academic platform joining membership administration with paper submissions, editorial review, working papers, journal archives, conference registration and public research content. Its workflows are shown as conceptual maps of documented modules—not confirmed end-to-end runtime journeys.
focus: One platform, several audiences: members, authors, reviewers, event participants and administrators. The architectural story is about reducing friction across the research lifecycle.
caveat: This source-only profile follows 36 entries in the uploaded inventory, pinned to a specific GitLab commit: 34 modules are marked present, KYC and HR are not found, only eight API routes were identified, and live PayPal/email/deployment behavior was not tested. Exact controller paths and personal contribution details were not supplied.

highlights.title: Membership & identity
highlights.body: Individual/institutional membership records, registration and dashboards with payment-handling code.

highlights.title: Editorial operations
highlights.body: Conference and general paper submissions, reviewer assignment, decisions, feedback and proofreading requests.

highlights.title: Research publishing
highlights.body: Journal and issue management, RePEc-related archive metadata, working papers and research datasets.

highlights.title: Events & discovery
highlights.body: Conference publishing, event registration, partner pages, news, galleries and public information management.

main.name: Prepare & submit
main.detail: Public and member-facing submission records support conference, general and working-paper uploads.

main.name: Route to review
main.detail: Reviewer assignments and feedback collection are source-present across paper and review services.

main.name: Evaluate & decide
main.detail: Review histories, responses and decision handling appear in the respective modules.

main.name: Publish & archive
main.detail: Proceedings, journal issues and working-paper series can be managed and published.

main.name: Make discoverable
main.detail: Journal pages, indexing content and dataset listings are documented discovery surfaces.

core.name: Join the community
core.detail: Individual and institutional membership forms capture separate member/application records.

core.name: Manage account
core.detail: Member dashboards surface account details and assigned or submitted research information.

core.name: Handle payments
core.detail: PayPal member payment and administrative payment-link handlers exist; live processing was not tested.

core.name: Explore events
core.detail: Conference publishing and listings expose forums, workshops and upcoming events.

core.name: Register & follow up
core.detail: Event registration and payment confirmation handlers are source-present, not runtime-certified.

scopeCards.title: Research workflows
scopeCards.body: Submission, peer review, proofreading, working papers, journal administration, conference proceedings and research data listings are present in the supplied source inventory.

scopeCards.title: Eight app API routes
scopeCards.body: The inventory identifies just eight routes for authentication, account/review lookup and public content. It does not establish a complete mobile CRUD or payment API.

scopeCards.title: Payments and production
scopeCards.body: PayPal checkout and payment-handling source exists, but merchant activation, processing success and deployment were not tested. Many database tables lack migrations in the inspected snapshot.
